gizmo.title: Qoraalka muusigga
gizmo.description: Muujiya oo shida qoraalka muusigga, tabab gitaar, iyo qoraalka heesaha iyadoo loo marayo alphaTex ama MusicXML.

configure.title: Qoraalka AlphaTex
configure.description: Calaamadeynta alphaTex ee gudaha ah ee qoraalka muusigga. Si toos ah wax uga beddel si aad u qorto; waxaa lagu kaydiyaa template si meelaha bannaan loo ilaaliyo.

configure.title: Faylka heesta
configure.description: Soo geli ama ku xiri fayl MusicXML (.xml/.musicxml/.mxl) ama Guitar Pro (.gp3/.gp4/.gp5/.gpx/.gp). Wuxuu ka mudnaan badan yahay alphaTex gudaha marka la dejiyo.

advanced.title: Ciyaarista maqalka
advanced.description: Caadi ahaan waa daaran yahay - dhegayso qoraalka muusigga oo lagu shiday synthesizer-ka ku dhex dhisan. Dami si aad u daawato oo keliya (maqal la'aan).

advanced.title: Muuji doorashooyinka muujinta
advanced.description: Muuji badhamada weynaynta, kala-bixinta, iyo qaabka ee bar-ka ciyaaraha.

advanced.title: Muuji badhamada dhoofinta
advanced.description: Muuji badhamada soo-dejinta MIDI iyo daabacaadda/PDF ee bar-ka ciyaaraha.
